title: Pullback map on etale cohomology
statement:
Let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with inverse image $u^{-1}G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and unit $\eta_u:\mathrm{id}\to u_*u^{-1}$ of $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Choose a resolution $G\to I^\bullet$ by a bounded below complex of injective abelian sheaves (a K-injective resolution [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions]) and a K-injective resolution $u^{-1}I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ on $Y_{\Et}$; since $u^{-1}$ is exact [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact], $u^{-1}G\to u^{-1}I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ is a K-injective resolution of $u^{-1}G$. The *pullback map*

$$
 u^*:H^q(X_{\Et},G)\longrightarrow H^q(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}G)\qquad(q\ge0)
$$

between the cohomology groups of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] is the map induced in degree $q$ by the morphism of complexes of abelian groups

$$
 \Gamma(X,I^\bullet)\xrightarrow{\ \eta_u\ }\Gamma(X,u_*u^{-1}I^\bullet)=\Gamma(Y,u^{-1}I^\bullet)\longrightarrow\Gamma(Y,J^\bullet),
$$

that is, a section $a\in I^r(X)$ goes to the image of $\eta_{u,I^r}(a)\in(u^{-1}I^r)(Y)$ in $J^r(Y)$ ("pull back the section, then compare with the resolution"). For $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$ the same recipe, with $I^\bullet$ a K-injective resolution of $K$, defines $u^*:\RGamma(X_{\Et},K)\to\RGamma(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}K)$ in $\Dplus(\Ab)$. The independence of the choices of $I^\bullet$ and $J^\bullet$ is the statement [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial], not part of this definition. When $u$ is etale (an object of $X_{\Et}$), $u^{-1}G=G|_Y$ and $u^*$ is the restriction map $H^q(X,G)\to H^q(Y,G|_Y)$.
